name: St. Patrick’s Festival Dublin 2027
job: Help Dublin visitors distinguish the festival programme from the national parade and make clear, user-controlled arrival and attendance scenarios.
source_notes: Organiser lists festival 13–17 March and 17 March parade start 12:00. Parade page says Parnell Square, FAQ says Granby Row; check current official route. Programme detail, closures, tickets and accessibility applications should be checked directly.
